rows.text: Law No. 15.436 of 17 June 2026, instituting the National Policy for Students with High Abilities or Giftedness, is enacted by 'O VICE–PRESIDENTE DA REPÚBLICA, no exercício do cargo de PRESIDENTE DA REPÚBLICA' ('Faço saber que o Congresso Nacional decreta e eu sanciono a seguinte Lei'), dated Brasília, 17 June 2026, and signed Geraldo José Rodrigues Alckmin Filho, countersigned by Janine Mello dos Santos, Dario Carnevalli Durigan and Leonardo Osvaldo Barchini Rosa; the page notes publication in the DOU of 18 June 2026.
